description:
Returns a list of all issue resolution values.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira.

application/json.example: [{"description":"A fix for this issue is checked into the tree and tested.","id":"10000","name":"Fixed","self":"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/resolution/1"},{"description":"This is what it is supposed to do.","id":"10001","name":"Works as designed","self":"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/resolution/3"}]

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.
